scope: Read-only operational diagnosis; this JSON is the only new artifact

saved_update_sample.update_timer_scope: Includes lazy observation mmap reads, CPU reconstruction, blocking host-to-device transfers, policy compute, backward and optimizer step; not GPU-only time
saved_update_sample.outside_timer_scope: Includes base-cache gather before update_started, prior logging/checkpoint work and control overhead; not an isolated I/O measurement

same_leaf_view_count_example.qualification: Equal leaf-view counts do not prove identical tensor shapes or compute

cache_metadata_evidence.interpretation: The 128-map global LRU is much smaller than the multi-task working set. Evicted files require another np.load header/open/mmap on reuse. Actual hit/miss counts and selected-group counts were not instrumented.
cache_metadata_evidence.existing_batch_memoization: Observations already caches by (probe, checkpoint, positions); repeated leaf/view observation reads within a batch are not a missing-cache defect
cache_metadata_evidence.backhaul_group_qualification: Actual TRAIN metadata has 51 groups for each MVRP task; no additional positive-demand-count fragmentation is claimed

one_optional_runtime_observation.outcome: No observation step acquired; pending diagnostic request cancelled without another attempt

srun: Cancelled pending job step with signal 15

one_optional_runtime_observation.cancellation_scope: Only the exact pending diagnostic srun command; no signal sent to trainer or observer
one_optional_runtime_observation.qualification: The cancellation message is not a terminal observation of formal training. GPU utilization, trainer CPU/I/O rates, RSS and FD limits remain unmeasured. The NFS path characterization comes from the parent's report, not a new mount probe.

diagnosis: Substantial data/control-path stalls are supported by the outside-timer wall time. Mmap reopening on the reported NFS cache paths is a plausible contributor, with observation reconstruction and transfer synchronization also inside the update timer. Available evidence does not quantify GPU compute versus I/O or establish one exclusive bottleneck. Free GPU memory does not support a batch change.

one_prospective_byte_identical_fix_not_a.fix: Stream-copy the complete immutable TRAIN/VAL cache groups to a read-only node-local disk mirror and redirect only cache-file opens through an isolated path resolver; retain original metadata identities, array bytes/dtypes/shapes, source-row alignment, order, 128-entry mmap bound and existing batch observation memoization
one_prospective_byte_identical_fix_not_a.disk_requirement: 39,669,947,000 bytes of stored array payload, plus source_indices, NPY headers, metadata and free-space headroom; node-local capacity has not been inspected
one_prospective_byte_identical_fix_not_a.memory_implications: Bounded streaming copy does not require an in-RAM copy of the roughly 37 GiB cache. File-backed pages remain reclaimable. Keep the existing 16 GiB job memory limit; actual process RSS is unknown.
one_prospective_byte_identical_fix_not_a.fd_implications: Retaining maxsize=128 keeps roughly 128 cached mmap descriptors plus existing baseline and transient opens. A cache holding the full TRAIN/VAL working set could instead retain up to 53,100 mappings/descriptors; its safety cannot be asserted without the actual limits.
one_prospective_byte_identical_fix_not_a.limits: Removes repeated remote-path opens/page reads after mirroring, but leaves CPU NumPy gather/token reconstruction, host-to-device synchronization and model compute unchanged. No throughput gain is measured or promised. Copy/loading wall must be charged separately.

resume_assessment_from_source_and_file_s.durable_clock_inference: The timestamp and source save cadence correspond to u1; saved update logs reached u16. No later checkpoint boundary was observed in this diagnosis.
resume_assessment_from_source_and_file_s.save_cadence: u1, every 60 updates and epoch end
resume_assessment_from_source_and_file_s.saved_state_fields: Complete averaged-x model; ScheduleFree optimizer including z, exp_avg_sq and group clocks/weight_sum/lr state; scaler/growth; RNG; epoch/next_step/accepted counters; best/history/lr trace and task/gradient counters
resume_assessment_from_source_and_file_s.exact_continuation_requirements: A separately authorized loader must restore the durable complete x state and optimizer/scaler/RNG/counters, then use the official optimizer.train() x-to-y transition once and continue the exact next scheduled triple. Reconstruct partial-epoch metric totals from already saved accepted update JSONL without forwards; those totals are not in last.pt.
resume_assessment_from_source_and_file_s.no_repeat_limit: Restarting from the observed u1 checkpoint would repeat already accepted later updates. A no-repeat continuation requires a durable boundary matching the accepted head. Logs alone cannot restore the later parameter or optimizer state. No restart or new resume code is authorized here.
